steps.comment: Attempt Eighty-Four: the fight, the stop, and the rebuild. The fight itself is proved the way battle_mook proves one - start it, look at what turned up, and leave the numbers to balance.py, because headless renders a battle at about three frames a second and a seven-thousand-hit-point boss would take the better part of an hour and would only re-test the renderer.

steps.comment: {advance} takes the default choice, which is 'Stop her', so this walks all the way into the battle. It overruns: advance presses confirm while $gameMap.isEventRunning(), and Battle Processing keeps the interpreter running for as long as the battle is up, so the spare presses land in Scene_Battle and queue actor commands. That is harmless here only because the very next thing this scenario does is abort the fight - do not copy the pattern into anything that has to survive the battle. Counting the presses instead was tried and is worse: it depends on whether each window had finished printing.
